newsitem.title: SWEDEN: INSTANT VIEW - Analysts view on Handelsbanken bid.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - Analysts view on Handelsbanken bid.

text.p: Analysts' reactions to Swedish bank Handelsbanken's 23 billion crown takeover bid for mortgage bank Stadshypotek.
The bid is good for Stadshypotek's shareholders as it offers a premium of nine crowns to the latest trading price.
Handelsbanken's shares were expensive already before this bid, probably because investors have speculated in share redemption, so this is not a good alternative for Handelsbanken.
Although the bid might be structurally right for Handelsbanken, it will be difficult for the bank to defend the 40 percent mortgage banking share it will get.
Currently, Handelsbanken has around 10 or 11 percent of that market, while Stadshypotek has around 29 percent.
The deal seems settled as the state accepts the bid.
When a bank, like Handelsbanken, shows (through the bid) that it focuses on core banking activitites, the market will interpret it favourably.
In addition, investors will get a lot of money, which are likely to reinvested in the financial sector.
